description: A composite figure of field-emission SEM images (secondary/back-scattered electron contrast) plus EDS elemental maps showing morphology and type of inclusions in the "2#" sample of Fe-15Mn-Al-C low-density steel. Row 1: (a) "AlN" — a dark, elongated, facetted single inclusion with a 10 μm scale bar; (b) "MnS" — a light octahedron-shaped particle, 4 μm scale bar; (c) "TiN" — a grey boot-shaped single particle, 3 μm scale bar; (d) "Al2O3-MnS" — a composite particle with labelled arrows, grey MnS and darker Al2O3 region, 2 μm scale bar. Row 2: (e) "AlN-MnS" composite, 4 μm scale bar, with arrows labelling the dark AlN and the lighter MnS, accompanied by four EDS maps of the same area labelled Al (red), N (orange), Mn (green) and S (magenta); (f) "Al2O3-AlN-MnS" composite, 5 μm scale bar, with arrows labelling MnS outer, AlN middle and Al2O3 inner core. Row 3: (g) "TiN-MnS" composite, 4 μm scale bar, with EDS maps of S (yellow), Mn (red), Ti (orange) and N (purple, with a dashed outline). The EDS maps co-localise Mn and S in one region and Al+N or Ti+N in another, demonstrating that the composite inclusions consist of oxide/nitride cores with sulfide shells. Panels are of two kinds: grey-scale electron micrographs (a–c, e–g left, f) and colour EDS elemental maps (e and g rows).

observations.observation: Panel (a) shows a single dark, elongated facetted AlN inclusion with a 10 μm scale bar.
Panel (b) shows an octahedron-shaped MnS inclusion with a 4 μm scale bar.
Panel (c) shows a single TiN inclusion with a boot-like morphology with a 3 μm scale bar.
Panel (d) labels a composite inclusion where grey represents the MnS and the darker region (arrow-labelled Al2O3) represents the Al2O3 inclusion; scale bar 2 μm.
The EDS maps beside panel (e) separate the Mn (green) and S (magenta) signal from the Al (red) and N (orange) signal.
Panel (e) arrows label AlN and MnS within the AlN-MnS composite inclusion; scale bar 4 μm.
Panel (f) shows an Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite inclusion with Al2O3 as the inner core, AlN as the middle layer and MnS outside; scale bar 5 μm.
The EDS maps beside panel (g) include S (yellow), Mn (red), Ti (orange) and N (purple, dashed outline) for a TiN-MnS inclusion.
Figure 2a shows a single AlN inclusion with a size of ≈23 μm.
Figure 2b shows the 3D morphology of MnS inclusions with an octahedron shape.
Figure 2d is the Al2O3-MnS composite inclusion where black represents Al2O3 and grey represents MnS.
Figure 2f shows Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite inclusions ordered Al2O3, AlN and MnS from the inside out.
The caption states panels a–c are single-particle inclusions and d–g are composite inclusions.
The paper abstract lists the inclusion types as Al2O3, AlN, MnS, TiN, Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS and Al2O3-AlN-MnS.
